svg.text: Fig. 5 — three readouts per arm: the honesty panel
Right-Ti mean duty, all 37 B39 arms · one row per arm, three readouts per row · rows sorted by chopped-gate duty (high → low)
chopped = 5-s-on/4-s-off gate at 0.7 Hz (16 matched seeds) · fast = continuous 1.4-Hz middle segment · cross = chopped, flex/ext from different seeds (240 ordered pairs, nonindependent)
mean duty — fraction of 500-sample windows with r(flex, ext) ≤ −0.25
dmA / dmC: chopped duty low, cross-seed duty high —
shared timing between seeds, not per-run gating (L184 Q3)
asserted vs threepanel.csv + results_l175.json at draw time · L184

row labels: green = carrier (DNp33-L) · purple = twins (mass sc26, drive dmA/dmC) · blue = boundary cells (sc27, sc40 — sc40 shares leading relay GI 75494) · orange = k=24 base · k columns: runs/pairs with duty ≥ .5 (16 seeds; cross 240) · no values missing
